shape.note: skimage.measure.regionprops on each single-cell polygon's own filled mask -- eccentricity=0/solidity=1 is a perfect circle; useful mainly for round cells (coc) where length/width aspect ratio alone doesn't capture non-circularity.

notes: psf_sigma is a coarse edge-spread proxy (amplitude / (p95 boundary gradient * sqrt(2*pi))), not a fitted optical model -- treat as order-of-magnitude guidance only. snr_db uses generate_dataset.py's own definition (20*log10(peak_signal/noise_std)) so it plugs directly into --species sampling ranges.
